goal: Demostrar una misión en la composición SessionManager + contexto + ReflexiveInterpreter + SPBE + razonador del host + PlanEngine + Spiral + autorización/gateway + observación + memoria.
reasoner: Actual ChatGPT conversational host, through a newly implemented ProviderAdapter mailbox; no fixed answer bank in live mode.
task: Reparar la persistencia de la selección explícita de proveedor y modelo en ConfigManager: guardar, reiniciar y recuperar sin sustituciones silenciosas; conservar defaults, reset, opciones ajenas y aislamiento de raíces.
integration_criteria: native SessionManager.send builds actual context envelopes and invokes the host adapter
native ReflexiveInterpreter and SPBE outputs reach actual host requests
host proposals, not evaluator solutions, are consumed by native PlanEngine and Spiral ACT
native authorization issues bounded single-use permits and native adapters execute writes and processes
independent test process sees real bytes and returns structured outcomes
REFLECT receives fresh observation and updates native ContextStore/LearningWriter
a new process recovers state and the host uses it without replaying the patch
STOP blocks new admission and explicit resume is required
limits: No automatic standalone reasoning provider is configured
Host delivery uses local mailbox; no authenticated external-user channel is certified
Single writer and sequential requests; not an OS sandbox
Native SPBE-to-PEC binding is not implemented or claimed
No performance, transfer or learning conclusion in this milestone
result_contract: Each native VERIFY check emits a typed COMPLETE integration report in addition to product outcomes; a failed diagnostic product is not labeled repaired.

real_target.copy: byte-identical canonical module from RC2; no fault injected
real_target.consumer: native SessionManager.__init__ and rebind_project_root instantiate ConfigManager
real_target.target_scope: isolated copy only; not an installed runtime

compatibility_decision: Retain defaults, remove implicit value-based migration for explicitly stored choices. No new migration subsystem.
